capabilities: Copy notes as WeChat-ready rich text
Preview the WeChat layout in a split pane or new tab
Apply layout themes, accent colors and typography settings
Add an opening header and closing hook
Convert links into numbered end references
disambiguation: Not a WeChat messaging or sync client; it only turns notes into rich text for pasting into the WeChat Official Account editor.
extras: Images must already use publicly accessible URLs; Obsidian WikiLinks and ![[local image]] embeds are not converted. Interface and commands are in Chinese. Formatting runs locally with no network requests.
problem: The WeChat Official Account editor strips Markdown formatting, so notes have to be restyled by hand before pasting.

relations.evidence: one option is Image Auto Upload Plugin with PicGo

summary: Converts a Markdown note into WeChat-ready rich text with themes, typography controls, link references and a live preview.
